title: mmt-plugin test --json result, schema_version 1
description: The result of test (docs/design/cli.md, section 6). Paths are relative to the project when inside it (POSIX separators), absolute otherwise. stages are always the five, in order; a stage the run did not reach, or did not ask for, is skipped. packets are in the order the packet tests were read, a test with through followed by its run through its parent; a session test is one entry. stats holds the only timing; everything else is the same on a re-run with the same inputs (the bench's numbers aside).

profile.description: The SDK profile the plugin is generated for.

build_dir.description: The directory of mmtp_<label>.so; the harness is in its test/ subdirectory, the sanitized plugin in sanitize/.

status.description: stale: build with --no-deps, when the plugin is not up to date. bench failed: advisory, the exit code is not changed.

skipped.description: Packets not run: an earlier stage failed, or --fail-fast stopped.

plugins.description: The other plugins plugin.yaml's plugins names (docs/plugin-yaml.md, Plugins), in the order every harness run loads them, before the plugin; empty without them. Filled as the build stage reaches them.

project.description: The project directory that builds it, or null for a .so file named directly.

build.description: The project's build: ran, up-to-date, stale (--no-deps), failed; null for a .so file, or a project the build stage did not reach.

through.description: The run through the plugin's real parent: the test's through selector, an mmt-dpi protocol's or a plugin parent's label (a project plugin.yaml's plugins names, behind one of its packet tests). Absent on the run the harness attaches to Ethernet.

session.description: A session test (its packets run in order in one harness, over one TCP connection): the number of packets it ran (an open step is three, an idle step one per second). Absent on a packet test.

attributes.description: The attributes checked (an undefined one is not); a session test's, over all its packets.

failures.description: Each mismatch: the attribute (<protocol> for the classification, <next> for the next protocol, <parent> for the protocol below the plugin's and its offset in a run through the parent, <harness> for a crash), the expected and the actual value, as display strings.

packet.description: A session test's: the index of the step of its packets list the failure is in. Absent on a packet test.

sanitize.description: The --sanitize run; null without it, or when it did not run.

count.description: The packets run under the sanitizers: each test's packet, then its --fuzz-count truncated and random packets; a test with through, those again behind its lower layers; a session test, its packets, then corrupted copies of them until they make at least --fuzz-count packets.

test.description: The packet test the packet comes from.

index.description: 0: the test's own packet; N: its Nth truncated or random packet for this seed. A session test's: 0, the session as written; N, its Nth corrupted copy for this seed.

packet.description: A session test's: the index of the step of its packets list the crashing packet comes from. Absent on a packet test.

bytes.description: The packet, as hex pairs (without the lower layers of a run through the parent or of a session test).

through.description: The test's through selector, when the packet ran behind its lower layers.

bench.description: The --bench run; null without it, or when it could not measure (a test.bench-failed warning).

pps.description: Packets per second with the plugin: the median sample.

baseline_pps.description: The same with an empty plugin of the same id and name.

samples.description: Packets per second of each sample, in order.
